Container.Name: dockerappblueprint-staging
Container.Overview: STAGING build for testing before production. Wizard that asks step by step what a new Docker app should be and generates a ready-to-paste build prompt for Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, including Unraid template rules, GitHub repo setup and documentation rules. Includes an OpenAI logo generator and a REST API for Hermes Agent. Default login after first start: admin / admin (you must change it immediately).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface (always 8000 inside the container).

Config.Name: Data (database, backups, logos, secret key)
Config.Description: SQLite database, automatic backups (backup/ folder), generated logos and the session key. Keep it on the array or cache so updates never lose data.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, used for backup times and logs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: OpenAI key for the logo generator. Can also be entered in Settings (stored encrypted).

Config.Name: DEFAULT_THEME
Config.Description: Optional: theme for a fresh install (daylight, midnight, nord, sand, forest).

Config.Name: BACKUP_ENABLED
Config.Description: Optional: automatic backups on or off for a fresh install (true/false). Changeable in Settings.

Config.Name: BACKUP_KEEP
Config.Description: Optional: number of backups to keep on a fresh install. Changeable in Settings.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Optional: true forces Secure cookies (only when you always use HTTPS through a reverse proxy).
